<beat id="tally" on="shower" title="Another one" once="false" advances="slot" when="holds('at', ['sol', 'roof'])">
  @sol{emotion="fond" when="occasion.payload.count == 1"}: That's one. Say a number every time.
  @sol{emotion="happy" when="occasion.payload.count > 1"}: {{occasion.payload.count:plural(# meteor|# meteors)}}. Keep going.
</beat>
